strings.camp.ch1.desc: Broke and alone, you stumble into the Rustvale scrapyard, where fallen legend Lao Qin takes you in and enters you in the Crash League qualifiers.
strings.camp.ch1_l1.desc: Take Lao Qin's tiny Lucciola into the Rust Bowl and come out alive.
strings.camp.ch1_l2.desc: Takedown: aim for the doors and score big with T-bones.
strings.camp.ch1_l3.desc: Clear Rusty's junk-filled Crusher Yard — without getting pancaked.
strings.camp.ch1_l4.desc: Ring Out atop the Junk Tower: angles beat brute force.
strings.camp.ch1_l5.desc: Bolt on the wedge and launch your rivals skyward.
strings.camp.ch1_l6.desc: Rusty's thick-skinned crew: get behind them and PIT them into a spin.
strings.camp.ch1_l7.desc: Team up with Xiaoyu for a 2v2 fight over the central hill.
strings.camp.ch1_l8.desc: Rival showdown: defeat Rusty, King of the Scrapyard, in the Rust Bowl.
strings.camp.ch2.desc: Smuggler-king Hook runs every match in Blackwater Docks. Refusing to throw a fight, you crack open the first seam of the League's dark secrets.
strings.camp.ch2_l1.desc: Your first Blackwater derby. Make Hook take notice.
strings.camp.ch2_l2.desc: A rain-slick pier in a storm: push rivals into the sea.
strings.camp.ch2_l3.desc: Refuse the fix — then survive Hook's container maze.
strings.camp.ch2_l4.desc: Rusty rides with you: 3v3 Team Takedown. Focus fire.
strings.camp.ch2_l5.desc: Smash the dockside crates and expose Hook's contraband.
strings.camp.ch2_l6.desc: Hook has sealed the port: hold out for two minutes until Rusty breaks in.
strings.camp.ch2_l7.desc: The whole port wants the bounty on Spark. Make the hunters crash into each other.
strings.camp.ch2_l8.desc: Rival showdown: sink Hook's black van on the storm-lashed pier.
strings.camp.ch3.desc: League chairman Mr. Bai personally courts you, while Scorpion, the deadliest driver in the desert, is paid to flip you over.
strings.camp.ch3_l1.desc: Sand means low grip. Use the jump pads and stay out of the holes.
strings.camp.ch3_l2.desc: Ring Out on a mesa thirty-five meters up. Mind the wind.
strings.camp.ch3_l3.desc: 3v3 King of the Hill: take the oasis back from the raiders.
strings.camp.ch3_l4.desc: Drop off a rock shelf onto someone's roof — that's called a crush.
strings.camp.ch3_l5.desc: Raiders attack under cover of a sandstorm. Survive for two and a half minutes.
strings.camp.ch3_l6.desc: The last derby before the Scorpion showdown. Six cars, one survivor.
strings.camp.ch3_l7.desc: Team Elimination drills with Rusty. Best of five.
strings.camp.ch3_l8.desc: Rival showdown: dodge the Scorpion-Tail Wedge and beat Scorpion from the flank.
strings.camp.ch4.desc: A witness to the final ten years ago hides in a frozen mountain pass. To hear the truth, you must beat the Lone Wolf on ice.
strings.camp.ch4_l1.desc: A third of normal grip: slide in sideways and sweep with your tail.
strings.camp.ch4_l2.desc: Scorpion joins in: 3v3 for the snow fort's courtyard.
strings.camp.ch4_l3.desc: White Wolf's pack waits on the ice shelf. Slide off and you're done.
strings.camp.ch4_l4.desc: Smash the fort's supply crates and force White Wolf out of hiding.
strings.camp.ch4_l5.desc: Mr. Bai's hunters trap you on the lake. Survive the blizzard.
strings.camp.ch4_l6.desc: Team with Scorpion to beat White Wolf's two lead wolves.
strings.camp.ch4_l7.desc: Sideways-on-ice training on the eve of the duel.
strings.camp.ch4_l8.desc: Rival showdown: one on one with the Lone Wolf on the frozen lake.
strings.camp.ch5.desc: The neon-lit Old Town belongs to street king Ghost — once Lao Qin's most beloved apprentice.
strings.camp.ch5_l1.desc: A derby in the neon-lit downtown plaza.
strings.camp.ch5_l2.desc: Floor it and jump the collapsed overpass.
strings.camp.ch5_l3.desc: Ring Out on a rooftop car park with no railings.
strings.camp.ch5_l4.desc: With Rusty and White Wolf, sweep Ghost's crew in a 3v3.
strings.camp.ch5_l5.desc: A wager with Ghost: win the Bounty Hunt and hear the truth.
strings.camp.ch5_l6.desc: The truth is out — and Mr. Bai's men pour in from every side.
strings.camp.ch5_l7.desc: One last Team Elimination session with White Wolf.
strings.camp.ch5_l8.desc: Rival showdown: midnight on the roof deck against Lao Qin's former apprentice.
strings.camp.ch6.desc: Mr. Bai's top enforcer Titan reaches for the people closest to you. This time, the betrayal comes from inside your own garage.
strings.camp.ch6_l1.desc: The League's ranked holy ground: a symmetrical steel arena.
strings.camp.ch6_l2.desc: Molten pits, presses and crane arms. Don't get greedy.
strings.camp.ch6_l3.desc: Rusty and Scorpion arrive: flip Titan's trucking crew on the runway.
strings.camp.ch6_l4.desc: Flatten the warehouse where Titan makes cheat parts for Mr. Bai.
strings.camp.ch6_l5.desc: Titan locks the Dome's doors. Survive two and a half minutes.
strings.camp.ch6_l6.desc: Your car has been sabotaged. Race Lao Qin's "Old Black", a 1969 muscle car.
strings.camp.ch6_l7.desc: Ghost leads the way and Xiaoyu drives: rescue her brother from Titan.
strings.camp.ch6_l8.desc: Rival showdown: topple nine tons of truck beside the furnace.
strings.camp.ch7.desc: Livestream queen Nightingale is ordered to eliminate you on camera — but she holds a secret that could topple the League.
strings.camp.ch7_l1.desc: Nightingale's opening stream: Ring Out forty floors up.
strings.camp.ch7_l2.desc: A pinball table come to life: 3v3 for the glowing hill.
strings.camp.ch7_l3.desc: The city's highest helipad, with Mr. Bai watching from the VIP box.
strings.camp.ch7_l4.desc: Nightingale puts a bounty on Spark. The whole arena is hunting you.
strings.camp.ch7_l5.desc: Mr. Bai's killers storm the roof. This isn't a match.
strings.camp.ch7_l6.desc: Team Elimination at the Neon Arcade, with Scorpion at your side.
strings.camp.ch7_l7.desc: The last warm-up. Every part on your car was fitted by Xiaoyu herself.
strings.camp.ch7_l8.desc: Rival showdown: an all-out duel with the Neon Queen in front of eighty million viewers.
strings.camp.ch8.desc: The Grand Final erupts in the Crash Colosseum. Old allies return, Iron Fist Qin races once more, and you face three-time Crash King Bai Ye.
strings.camp.ch8_l1.desc: Finals Week opens with an eight-car derby in the Colosseum.
strings.camp.ch8_l2.desc: The sweeper arm never stops. Last car on the ring advances.
strings.camp.ch8_l3.desc: Mr. Bai changes the format: your old crew against a pro hypercar team.
strings.camp.ch8_l4.desc: Smash the cheat parts hidden in the Colosseum and keep the final clean.
strings.camp.ch8_l5.desc: Side by side with Ghost: pairs Team Elimination in the Steel Dome.
strings.camp.ch8_l6.desc: Mr. Bai's "security drill": six armored heavies, three minutes.
strings.camp.ch8_l7.desc: Iron Fist Qin returns in "Old Black": 3v3 King of the Hill.
strings.camp.ch8_l8.desc: The Grand Final: defeat three-time Crash King Bai Ye in the Crash Colosseum.
strings.camp.rival_crown.title: Reigning Crash King
strings.camp.rival_ghost.title: Phantom of the Night City
strings.camp.rival_hook.title: Smuggler of Blackwater
strings.camp.rival_neon.title: Neon Queen
strings.camp.rival_rust.title: King of the Scrapyard
strings.camp.rival_scorpion.title: Sting of the Sands
strings.camp.rival_titan.title: Lord of the Ironworks
strings.camp.rival_wolf.title: Lone Wolf of the Pass
strings.dlg.ch1_l1.intro.1: camp.char_qin|Hey, kid. Digging through my scrap for parts? You've got nerve.
strings.dlg.ch1_l1.intro.2: camp.char_spark|I heard someone runs underground crash fights in Rustvale. I want in.
strings.dlg.ch1_l1.intro.3: camp.char_qin|The Crash League isn't a playground. Take this little Lucciola into the Rust Bowl. Come out alive and we'll talk.
strings.dlg.ch1_l1.intro.4: camp.char_yu|Uncle, I haven't even changed the brake pads on that thing!
strings.dlg.ch1_l1.intro.5: camp.char_qin|Perfect. In a crash fight, brakes are for cowards.
strings.dlg.ch1_l1.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|A pipsqueak just walked out of the Rust Bowl! Whose is that?
strings.dlg.ch1_l1.outro.2: camp.char_qin|...Not bad. Hits hard, dodges fast, like a spark. From now on, your name is Spark.
strings.dlg.ch1_l1.outro.3: camp.char_yu|I'm Xiaoyu. Your car's my responsibility now. Deal: you wreck it, you buy me bubble tea.
strings.dlg.ch1_l2.intro.1: camp.char_qin|Takedown: get wrecked and you respawn instantly. Points are all that matter.
strings.dlg.ch1_l2.intro.2: camp.char_qin|Remember, T-bones score the most. Aim for the door and floor it.
strings.dlg.ch1_l2.intro.3: camp.char_yu|That pit in the middle eats cars. Nobody's fishing you out.
strings.dlg.ch1_l2.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Rookie Spark with a clean T-bone! The Rustvale old-timers are starting to whisper.
strings.dlg.ch1_l2.outro.2: camp.char_spark|This is the League? It's crazier than I imagined.
strings.dlg.ch1_l2.outro.3: camp.char_qin|This is just qualifying. The real lunatics haven't shown up yet.
strings.dlg.ch1_l3.intro.1: camp.char_yu|Rusty filled the Crusher Yard with junk. Says whoever clears it earns the right to meet him.
strings.dlg.ch1_l3.intro.2: camp.char_qin|Rusty... that old goat still calls himself King of the Scrapyard. Go smash crates, and don't get pancaked by the crushers.
strings.dlg.ch1_l3.outro.1: camp.rival_rust|Who's the brat that smashed my collection to bits?!
strings.dlg.ch1_l3.outro.2: camp.char_spark|You said clear it and I'd meet you. It's clear.
strings.dlg.ch1_l3.outro.3: camp.rival_rust|Ha! You've got guts. Remember the Rustvale rule: if you want to rise, you go through me.
strings.dlg.ch1_l4.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|Junk Tower Ring Out! Twenty meters up, no rails, fall and you're out!
strings.dlg.ch1_l4.intro.2: camp.char_qin|Ring-outs aren't about strength, they're about angles. Push from the side and let them slide off.
strings.dlg.ch1_l4.outro.1: camp.char_yu|When you scraped past the edge, my heart stopped!
strings.dlg.ch1_l4.outro.3: camp.char_qin|Fear is good. Scared drivers live longer.
strings.dlg.ch1_l5.intro.1: camp.char_yu|I spent the last prize money welding a steel plate. Behold: the legendary wedge!
strings.dlg.ch1_l5.intro.2: camp.char_qin|The wedge slides under their bumper, lifts, and up they go. We call it "launching".
strings.dlg.ch1_l5.intro.4: camp.char_qin|The Crash League has one iron rule: nothing that flies off your car to hurt people. Everything else is called technique.
strings.dlg.ch1_l5.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|One, two — Spark is launching cars into the sky! It's raining cars over Rustvale tonight!
strings.dlg.ch1_l5.outro.2: camp.rival_rust|Had your fun, kid? Next Saturday, Rust Bowl, you and me.
strings.dlg.ch1_l6.intro.1: camp.rival_rust|Want a shot at me? Get through my boys first.
strings.dlg.ch1_l6.intro.2: camp.char_qin|Rusty's crew drive thick-skinned vans. Don't go head-on. Get behind them and PIT.
strings.dlg.ch1_l6.intro.3: camp.char_yu|A PIT is a nudge on their rear corner so they spin themselves out!
strings.dlg.ch1_l6.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Rusty's whole crew is wrecked! Saturday's showdown is going to be something!
strings.dlg.ch1_l7.intro.1: camp.char_yu|Last warm-up before the duel, and I'm driving with you! Two on two, fight for the zone in the middle.
strings.dlg.ch1_l7.intro.2: camp.char_qin|King of the Hill, remember one thing: a car parked in the circle is a sitting duck.
strings.dlg.ch1_l7.outro.1: camp.char_yu|We won! Told you my tuning is the best!
strings.dlg.ch1_l7.outro.2: camp.char_qin|Spark, Rusty and I ran the League together back in the day. Foul temper, iron hands. Don't underestimate him tomorrow.
strings.dlg.ch1_l7.outro.3: camp.char_spark|You raced in the League too?
strings.dlg.ch1_l7.outro.4: camp.char_qin|...That was a long time ago.
strings.dlg.ch1_l8.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|Saturday night, the Rust Bowl is packed! On the left, thirty years King of the Scrapyard — RUSTY!
strings.dlg.ch1_l8.intro.2: camp.char_announcer|On the right, the rookie who was digging through trash two weeks ago — SPARK!
strings.dlg.ch1_l8.intro.3: camp.rival_rust|Qin, this is your apprentice? My old cruiser has wrecked more cars than this kid has ever seen!
strings.dlg.ch1_l8.intro.4: camp.char_qin|Ten years, Rusty, and your mouth is still faster than your car.
strings.dlg.ch1_l8.intro.5: camp.rival_rust|Hmph. Kid, beat me and this Patrolman is yours. Lose, and you leave Rustvale!
strings.dlg.ch1_l8.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Unbelievable! The Rustvale throne has a new owner!
strings.dlg.ch1_l8.outro.2: camp.rival_rust|Cough... good kid. Take the keys. This old partner's been with me twenty years.
strings.dlg.ch1_l8.outro.3: camp.rival_rust|One more thing. Qin won't say it, so I will: the crash that ended his career ten years ago was no accident. Someone tampered with his car.
strings.dlg.ch1_l8.outro.5: camp.rival_rust|If you want to know, crash your way to the top of the League. Next stop: Blackwater Docks.
strings.dlg.ch2_l1.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|Welcome to the Blackwater circuit! There's only one rule here: Hook's word is law.
strings.dlg.ch2_l1.intro.2: camp.char_yu|The drivers around here run smuggled rides. Watch yourself.
strings.dlg.ch2_l1.intro.3: camp.char_qin|A nice car doesn't make a good driver. Show them some Rustvale craftsmanship.
strings.dlg.ch2_l1.outro.1: camp.rival_hook|The Rustvale rookie? Interesting. Name's Hook. Every container in this port belongs to me.
strings.dlg.ch2_l1.outro.2: camp.rival_hook|Drop by my office sometime. Let's talk business.
strings.dlg.ch2_l2.intro.1: camp.char_yu|Ring Out on a pier in a storm... are these people insane?
strings.dlg.ch2_l2.intro.2: camp.char_qin|Wet decks make pushing easy, and falling easier. Go slow. Let them make the mistakes.
strings.dlg.ch2_l2.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Three more cars in the sea! Spark is the last one standing!
strings.dlg.ch2_l3.intro.1: camp.rival_hook|Spark, I'll be straight: lose the next match and I pay you a hundred grand.
strings.dlg.ch2_l3.intro.3: camp.rival_hook|Don't be crude. It's "a business partnership." The big shots upstairs all play this way.
strings.dlg.ch2_l3.intro.4: camp.char_spark|Then you picked the wrong driver.
strings.dlg.ch2_l3.intro.5: camp.rival_hook|Heh. Then let's see how long you last in my maze.
strings.dlg.ch2_l3.outro.1: camp.char_yu|You actually turned down a hundred grand?! ...Well done. But you're paying for your own bubble tea now.
strings.dlg.ch2_l3.outro.2: camp.char_qin|"The big shots upstairs," he said. Hmph. The League's waters are as muddy as ever.
strings.dlg.ch2_l4.intro.1: camp.char_yu|Hook hired three goons to deal with you. But — look who showed up!
strings.dlg.ch2_l4.intro.2: camp.rival_rust|Only Rustvale gets to push around Rustvale folk. Kid, I've got your back.
strings.dlg.ch2_l4.intro.3: camp.char_qin|Three-on-three Team Takedown. Don't freelance. Focus the same car.
strings.dlg.ch2_l4.outro.1: camp.rival_rust|Hahaha! Glorious! Haven't had a smash this good in years!
strings.dlg.ch2_l5.intro.1: camp.char_yu|I found it. Hook's contraband is hidden in those crates on the dock.
strings.dlg.ch2_l5.intro.2: camp.char_qin|Smash them open. Let everyone see what's inside.
strings.dlg.ch2_l5.outro.1: camp.char_spark|These crates... they're stamped with the Crash League emblem?
strings.dlg.ch2_l5.outro.2: camp.char_qin|Official League cargo on a smuggler's dock. Someone's standing behind Hook.
strings.dlg.ch2_l6.intro.1: camp.rival_hook|You saw something you shouldn't have. Boys, don't let Spark leave the docks!
strings.dlg.ch2_l6.intro.2: camp.char_yu|All exits are blocked! Hold on for two minutes, I'll get Rusty to break the gate!
strings.dlg.ch2_l6.outro.1: camp.rival_rust|Out of the way! The Patrolman's coming through!
strings.dlg.ch2_l6.outro.3: camp.rival_rust|That girl Xiaoyu nearly blew out my eardrum. Come on, let's settle up with Hook.
strings.dlg.ch2_l7.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|Hook has put a bounty on Spark across the whole port! Wreck Spark for double pay!
strings.dlg.ch2_l7.intro.2: camp.char_qin|When you're hunted, the best defense is making your hunters crash into each other.
strings.dlg.ch2_l7.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|The bounty hunters are dropping one by one! Hook can't sit still now!
strings.dlg.ch2_l7.outro.2: camp.rival_hook|Fine. Very fine. Tonight, Crane Pier. I'll put you in the sea myself.
strings.dlg.ch2_l8.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|Crane Pier in the storm! Hook, King of Blackwater, takes the wheel of his black van himself!
strings.dlg.ch2_l8.intro.2: camp.rival_hook|Know how much cargo this van has moved? Tonight it moves you — into the sea.
strings.dlg.ch2_l8.intro.3: camp.char_spark|A smuggler's van belongs at the bottom of the sea.
strings.dlg.ch2_l8.intro.4: camp.rival_hook|Big talk! One word from my backers and you're finished in the League!
strings.dlg.ch2_l8.intro.5: camp.char_qin|Spark, his battering ram is unbeatable head-on. Get to his flank.
strings.dlg.ch2_l8.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|The black van plunges into the sea! There's a new order in Blackwater!
strings.dlg.ch2_l8.outro.2: camp.rival_hook|Cough... you think beating me ends it? Mr. Bai won't let this go...
strings.dlg.ch2_l8.outro.4: camp.char_qin|...Mr. Bai. Chairman of the Crash League.
strings.dlg.ch2_l8.outro.5: camp.char_yu|We fished the van out! A rinse and it'll run. It's yours!
strings.dlg.ch3_l1.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|Welcome to Scorpion Sands! The sand swallows cars and the Scorpion eats drivers!
strings.dlg.ch3_l1.intro.2: camp.char_yu|Sand has poor grip, so lift early for corners. The jump pads can send you flying — or into a hole.
strings.dlg.ch3_l1.outro.1: camp.char_bai|A thrilling match. I'm Mr. Bai, Chairman of the Crash League.
strings.dlg.ch3_l1.outro.2: camp.char_bai|The League needs new stars like you. Interested in a sponsorship contract?
strings.dlg.ch3_l1.outro.4: camp.char_qin|(quietly) Don't touch anything he offers you.
strings.dlg.ch3_l2.intro.1: camp.char_qin|Mr. Bai... ten years, and he still wears that tiger's smile.
strings.dlg.ch3_l2.intro.3: camp.char_qin|Race first. The Mesa is thirty-five meters up. Cars that fall come down as scrap.
strings.dlg.ch3_l2.outro.1: camp.char_yu|The wind up there was brutal. From down here it looked like you were on a tightrope.
strings.dlg.ch3_l2.outro.2: camp.char_qin|Spark, ten years ago I was League champion. The night before the final, Mr. Bai asked me to throw it. I refused.
strings.dlg.ch3_l2.outro.3: camp.char_qin|The next day, my brakes failed.
strings.dlg.ch3_l3.intro.1: camp.char_yu|Scorpion's raiders have seized the oasis and won't let other drivers refill.
strings.dlg.ch3_l3.intro.2: camp.rival_rust|Three-on-three King of the Hill. Hold the palms and let these sand rats drink dust!
strings.dlg.ch3_l3.outro.1: camp.rival_scorpion|...The oasis is yours. Next time, on the dunes, I'll launch you myself.
strings.dlg.ch3_l3.outro.3: camp.rival_rust|Scorpion. Meanest driver in the desert. Her wedge can flip a truck.
strings.dlg.ch3_l4.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|Quarry Pit Takedown! A central pit, dump trucks and a rock crusher — every one of them deadly!
strings.dlg.ch3_l4.intro.2: camp.char_yu|Drop off a rock shelf onto someone's roof — that's a crush, and it scores big.
strings.dlg.ch3_l4.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Spark's aerial show today was pure art!
strings.dlg.ch3_l4.outro.2: camp.char_bai|Spark, my sponsorship offer still stands. Don't let Qin's old stories hold back your future.
strings.dlg.ch3_l4.outro.3: camp.char_spark|How do you know what he told me?
strings.dlg.ch3_l4.outro.4: camp.char_bai|Nothing happens in the League that I don't know about.
strings.dlg.ch3_l5.intro.1: camp.char_yu|Sandstorm incoming! Scorpion's raiders are using it as cover to surround you!
strings.dlg.ch3_l5.intro.2: camp.char_qin|When you can't see, listen for engines. Don't stop. Stopping makes you a target.
strings.dlg.ch3_l5.outro.1: camp.char_spark|Phew... why are they fighting so hard?
strings.dlg.ch3_l5.outro.2: camp.rival_scorpion|Because Mr. Bai paid us to stop you. ...Pity the money wasn't enough.
strings.dlg.ch3_l6.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|The final derby before the Scorpion showdown! Six cars, one survivor!
strings.dlg.ch3_l6.intro.2: camp.char_yu|Scorpion's watching from the stands. She's studying your lines.
strings.dlg.ch3_l6.outro.1: camp.rival_scorpion|You always twitch left before a corner. Tomorrow, I'll be waiting right there.
strings.dlg.ch3_l6.outro.2: camp.char_qin|She's right. Fix it. Practice tonight.
strings.dlg.ch3_l7.intro.1: camp.rival_rust|Qin asked me to run Team Elimination drills with you. Best of five, no respawns.
strings.dlg.ch3_l7.intro.2: camp.char_qin|In Elimination, staying alive matters more than takedowns. Don't charge ahead. Let Rusty draw fire.
strings.dlg.ch3_l7.outro.1: camp.rival_rust|Nice teamwork, kid. Scorpion's all yours.
strings.dlg.ch3_l7.outro.2: camp.char_spark|Her wedge... how do I beat it?
strings.dlg.ch3_l7.outro.3: camp.rival_rust|Wedges hate the flank. Never let her face you head-on.
strings.dlg.ch3_l8.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|Desert showdown! Scorpion rolls out in her Dune pickup, Scorpion-Tail Wedge bolted on!
strings.dlg.ch3_l8.intro.2: camp.rival_scorpion|I've flipped a hundred cars in these sands. You'll be number one hundred and one.
strings.dlg.ch3_l8.intro.3: camp.char_spark|Why help Mr. Bai stop me? What's in it for you?
strings.dlg.ch3_l8.intro.4: camp.rival_scorpion|What's in it? ...Five years ago I refused to throw a race for him, and he kicked me out of the League. Now I only care about money.
strings.dlg.ch3_l8.intro.5: camp.char_qin|She's another of Bai's victims, like me. Spark, beat her — then give her a hand up.
strings.dlg.ch3_l8.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Scorpion... has been flipped! The desert has a new ruler!
strings.dlg.ch3_l8.outro.2: camp.rival_scorpion|Heh... number one hundred and one turned out to be me.
strings.dlg.ch3_l8.outro.3: camp.rival_scorpion|Take the truck. Go find White Wolf. He was at that final ten years ago.
strings.dlg.ch3_l8.outro.5: camp.rival_scorpion|Up north, in the snow mountains. He sees no one — unless you can beat him on ice.
strings.dlg.ch4_l1.intro.1: camp.char_yu|Ice has a third of normal grip! I packed snow chains for you. Don't complain they're slow.
strings.dlg.ch4_l1.intro.2: camp.char_qin|Crashing on ice is about who stops first. Slide in sideways and sweep them with your tail.
strings.dlg.ch4_l1.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|On the frozen lake, Spark is waltzing!
strings.dlg.ch4_l1.outro.2: camp.rival_wolf|...Not bad. But the lake is only the doorstep.
strings.dlg.ch4_l2.intro.1: camp.rival_scorpion|Don't get the wrong idea. I just want to see who White Wolf loses to.
strings.dlg.ch4_l2.intro.2: camp.rival_rust|Hey, Scorpion's here? Rustvale and the Sands are one big family now.
strings.dlg.ch4_l2.intro.3: camp.char_qin|The fort's snow walls are soft — use them as cushions. Take the center!
strings.dlg.ch4_l2.outro.1: camp.rival_scorpion|Not bad. A little better than I expected.
strings.dlg.ch4_l2.outro.2: camp.rival_wolf|Three of you for one snow fort... how lively. Tomorrow, Glacier Shelf. Come alone.
strings.dlg.ch4_l3.intro.1: camp.rival_wolf|My pack will teach you what sliding really means on ice.
strings.dlg.ch4_l3.intro.2: camp.char_yu|Ring Out on ice... how is this different from bumper cars on a skating rink?!
strings.dlg.ch4_l3.intro.3: camp.char_qin|The difference is, the ones who fall don't get back up.
strings.dlg.ch4_l3.outro.1: camp.rival_wolf|The whole pack is over the edge. ...You remind me of someone.
strings.dlg.ch4_l3.outro.3: camp.rival_wolf|The champion from ten years ago. "Iron Fist" Qin.
strings.dlg.ch4_l4.intro.1: camp.char_yu|White Wolf's camp lives off the supply crates in the fort. Smash them and he'll have to come see you.
strings.dlg.ch4_l4.intro.3: camp.char_qin|Relax. He's hidden in these mountains for ten years. He won't starve.
strings.dlg.ch4_l4.outro.1: camp.rival_wolf|...You're the first in ten years who dared wreck my supplies. Fine. What do you want to know?
strings.dlg.ch4_l4.outro.2: camp.char_spark|The final ten years ago. Qin's brakes.
strings.dlg.ch4_l4.outro.3: camp.rival_wolf|The brake line was cut. That night I saw a young man slip out of Qin's garage. His apprentice.
strings.dlg.ch4_l5.intro.1: camp.char_bai|(over the radio) Spark, you know too much. Enjoy the blizzard.
strings.dlg.ch4_l5.intro.2: camp.char_yu|Bai's people are all around the lake! They want to trap you out on the ice!
strings.dlg.ch4_l5.intro.3: camp.rival_wolf|Hold on, kid. A wolf never abandons its pack.
strings.dlg.ch4_l5.outro.1: camp.rival_wolf|Bai's dogs have all run off.
strings.dlg.ch4_l5.outro.3: camp.rival_wolf|Because ten years ago, I said nothing. This time, I won't stay silent.
strings.dlg.ch4_l6.intro.1: camp.rival_wolf|To duel me, first beat my two lead wolves. Team Elimination, best of five.
strings.dlg.ch4_l6.intro.2: camp.rival_scorpion|I'll ride with you. Don't slow me down this time.
strings.dlg.ch4_l6.outro.2: camp.rival_wolf|Tomorrow morning, the frozen lake. One on one.
strings.dlg.ch4_l7.intro.1: camp.char_qin|White Wolf's rally car grips ice like it has claws. Last warm-up tonight: practice your slides.
strings.dlg.ch4_l7.intro.2: camp.char_yu|I softened the suspension a bit. It'll track better on the ice.
strings.dlg.ch4_l7.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Tomorrow, Whitewolf Pass hosts its first public duel in ten years!
strings.dlg.ch4_l7.outro.2: camp.char_qin|Spark... if Wolf is telling the truth, that apprentice...
strings.dlg.ch4_l8.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|The frozen lake, one on one! The Lone Wolf of the Pass, White Wolf, competing for the first time in ten years!
strings.dlg.ch4_l8.intro.2: camp.rival_wolf|Ten years ago I watched a champion get destroyed and did nothing.
strings.dlg.ch4_l8.intro.3: camp.rival_wolf|Today I want to see if the one he trained deserves to set things right.
strings.dlg.ch4_l8.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|White Wolf is beaten! Spark has conquered Whitewolf Pass!
strings.dlg.ch4_l8.outro.2: camp.rival_wolf|Good. Very good. This car has been with me ten years. Now it's yours.
strings.dlg.ch4_l8.outro.3: camp.rival_wolf|The apprentice's name was Ah Ying. These days the city calls him... Ghost.
strings.dlg.ch5_l1.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|The Old Town circuit opens! Under the neon lights, this is street king Ghost's turf!
strings.dlg.ch5_l1.intro.2: camp.char_qin|Ah Ying... was my first apprentice. An orphan. I raised him like my own son.
strings.dlg.ch5_l1.outro.1: camp.rival_ghost|Old master. Long time. Got yourself a new apprentice?
strings.dlg.ch5_l1.outro.3: camp.rival_ghost|Don't call me that. Ah Ying died ten years ago.
strings.dlg.ch5_l2.intro.1: camp.rival_ghost|Want answers from me? Survive my overpass first.
strings.dlg.ch5_l2.intro.2: camp.char_yu|There's a gap in the middle of the interchange. Hit it fast enough and you can jump it!
strings.dlg.ch5_l2.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Spark flies the broken bridge! Ghost's crew is stunned!
strings.dlg.ch5_l2.outro.2: camp.rival_ghost|...Nice flying. But in this city, flying alone won't keep you alive.
strings.dlg.ch5_l3.intro.1: camp.char_yu|Ghost's turf is all rooftop car parks. The railings on these buildings got knocked off long ago.
strings.dlg.ch5_l3.intro.2: camp.char_qin|Ah Ying always loved racing on rooftops. Said you have to stand high to see the whole city.
strings.dlg.ch5_l3.outro.1: camp.rival_ghost|You still remember that, old master?
strings.dlg.ch5_l3.outro.2: camp.char_qin|I remember every word you ever said.
strings.dlg.ch5_l3.outro.3: camp.rival_ghost|...Then you should also remember you never once let me race in a real match.
strings.dlg.ch5_l4.intro.1: camp.rival_rust|Patrolman on duty! These streets are ours tonight.
strings.dlg.ch5_l4.intro.3: camp.char_qin|Three on three. Ghost's crew drive slippery lines. Stay glued to their tails.
strings.dlg.ch5_l4.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|The street king's crew loses at home for the first time!
strings.dlg.ch5_l4.outro.2: camp.rival_ghost|You think numbers win? Tomorrow night, the interchange. Let's make a bet.
strings.dlg.ch5_l5.intro.1: camp.rival_ghost|Simple rules: Bounty Hunt. You win, I tell you the truth about ten years ago. You lose, you and Qin leave this city.
strings.dlg.ch5_l5.intro.3: camp.char_yu|Spark, the bounty sits on the top scorer... the more you win, the more people hunt you.
strings.dlg.ch5_l5.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Spark breaks through with the bounty still on!
strings.dlg.ch5_l5.outro.2: camp.rival_ghost|...Fine. The truth: that night, the one who cut the brake line was me.
strings.dlg.ch5_l5.outro.4: camp.rival_ghost|Because Mr. Bai promised that once you went down, the champion's seat would be mine.
strings.dlg.ch5_l6.intro.1: camp.char_yu|The moment Ghost said it, cars came from every direction! Bai's men!
strings.dlg.ch5_l6.intro.2: camp.char_qin|Spark, survive first. We'll settle accounts later.
strings.dlg.ch5_l6.outro.2: camp.char_qin|Ten years... I always believed it was my own fault.
strings.dlg.ch5_l6.outro.3: camp.char_qin|Spark, win tomorrow night for me. Not for revenge — to wake Ah Ying up.
strings.dlg.ch5_l7.intro.1: camp.rival_wolf|Ghost's car is absurdly fast. Tonight we run Elimination together. Find your rhythm.
strings.dlg.ch5_l7.intro.2: camp.char_yu|I re-tuned your whole car top to bottom. Fresh suspension, fresh brakes.
strings.dlg.ch5_l7.outro.3: camp.rival_wolf|So is he. For ten years, he's been waiting for Qin's people to come find him.
strings.dlg.ch5_l8.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|Midnight, top of the car park! King of the Night City, Ghost, versus Spark of Rustvale!
strings.dlg.ch5_l8.intro.2: camp.rival_ghost|Everything the old master taught you, he taught me ten years ago.
strings.dlg.ch5_l8.intro.3: camp.rival_ghost|But what he didn't teach, I learned in this city on my own.
strings.dlg.ch5_l8.intro.6: camp.char_qin|Ah Ying! Win or lose today — after this, come home.
strings.dlg.ch5_l8.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Ghost is down! The Night City's night belongs to Spark!
strings.dlg.ch5_l8.outro.2: camp.rival_ghost|...I lost. Old master, you trained a fine apprentice.
strings.dlg.ch5_l8.outro.3: camp.char_qin|You were a fine apprentice too. You just took the wrong road.
strings.dlg.ch5_l8.outro.4: camp.rival_ghost|The car's yours, Spark. Mr. Bai has another enforcer in the industrial district, called Titan. And — watch the people close to you.
strings.dlg.ch5_l8.outro.6: camp.rival_ghost|Mr. Bai's specialty is forcing people to betray those closest to them. I'm the proof.
strings.dlg.ch6_l1.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|The Ironworks circuit! This is the League's ranked holy ground — the Steel Dome!
strings.dlg.ch6_l1.intro.3: camp.char_spark|Xiaoyu, what's wrong? You've barely said a word for two days.
strings.dlg.ch6_l1.outro.1: camp.rival_titan|You're the one who made Ghost cry?
strings.dlg.ch6_l1.outro.2: camp.rival_titan|In my district, your bones get pressed into sheet metal.
strings.dlg.ch6_l1.outro.3: camp.char_qin|Titan. Bai's number one enforcer. He drives a semi tractor with no trailer.
strings.dlg.ch6_l2.intro.1: camp.char_qin|The foundry's molten pits, presses and crane arms can all kill you. Don't get greedy.
strings.dlg.ch6_l2.intro.2: camp.char_yu|I... I'm going to check the spare tire.
strings.dlg.ch6_l2.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Spark is dancing on the edge of the furnace!
strings.dlg.ch6_l2.outro.2: camp.char_spark|Xiaoyu keeps hiding in the garage making phone calls.
strings.dlg.ch6_l3.intro.1: camp.rival_scorpion|Heard you've got a target on your back in the Ironworks. Thought I'd swing by.
strings.dlg.ch6_l3.intro.2: camp.rival_rust|Swing by? She drove all night from the desert.
strings.dlg.ch6_l3.outro.1: camp.rival_rust|Ha! Flipping three trucks on the runway — glorious!
strings.dlg.ch6_l3.outro.2: camp.char_yu|Everyone... is so good to Spark.
strings.dlg.ch6_l4.intro.1: camp.char_qin|Titan's factory makes "race-special" cheat parts for Mr. Bai. Flatten the warehouse.
strings.dlg.ch6_l4.intro.3: camp.char_qin|Bai controls the League's parts supply. Whoever he wants to win gets the good parts.
strings.dlg.ch6_l4.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Titan's warehouse has been razed to the ground!
strings.dlg.ch6_l4.outro.2: camp.rival_titan|You wrecked my factory... before the final, I'll wreck you with my own hands.
strings.dlg.ch6_l5.intro.1: camp.rival_titan|Lock the Dome's doors. Nobody leaves alive today.
strings.dlg.ch6_l5.intro.3: camp.char_spark|Xiaoyu? What are you talking about?
strings.dlg.ch6_l5.outro.1: camp.char_spark|The brakes... something's wrong with the brakes!
strings.dlg.ch6_l5.outro.2: camp.char_qin|Spark, stop the car! Don't move!
strings.dlg.ch6_l5.outro.3: camp.char_qin|Someone sliced the brake line... just like ten years ago.
strings.dlg.ch6_l6.intro.1: camp.char_yu|It was me. Titan has my brother. He said if I didn't do it...
strings.dlg.ch6_l6.intro.4: camp.char_yu|Uncle, I'm sorry... I'm so sorry...
strings.dlg.ch6_l6.intro.5: camp.char_qin|Until Spark's car is fixed, take my "Old Black." A 1969 classic. Hasn't raced in twenty years.
strings.dlg.ch6_l6.intro.6: camp.char_qin|Xiaoyu, we'll handle your brother together. This time, nobody gets forced by Bai to betray their family.
strings.dlg.ch6_l6.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|A muscle car more than fifty years old just swept the whole airfield!
strings.dlg.ch6_l6.outro.3: camp.char_qin|It was a champion in its day too.
strings.dlg.ch6_l6.outro.4: camp.char_yu|Spark... I fixed your car overnight. This time I checked every single bolt three times.
strings.dlg.ch6_l7.intro.1: camp.rival_ghost|I told you to watch the people close to you. ...I never said you couldn't forgive her.
strings.dlg.ch6_l7.intro.3: camp.rival_ghost|Titan is holding Xiaoyu's brother under the Dome. I know the way.
strings.dlg.ch6_l7.intro.4: camp.char_yu|This time, let me drive too!
strings.dlg.ch6_l7.outro.2: camp.rival_ghost|He's out. Old master... I'll start repaying what I owe you today.
strings.dlg.ch6_l8.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|The foundry is boiling! Bai's top enforcer, TITAN, rolls in with nine tons of truck!
strings.dlg.ch6_l8.intro.2: camp.rival_titan|Xiaoyu couldn't finish off your car. So I'll finish you.
strings.dlg.ch6_l8.intro.3: camp.char_yu|Titan! Today you pay for kidnapping my brother!
strings.dlg.ch6_l8.intro.4: camp.char_spark|Every bolt she tightened was for today.
strings.dlg.ch6_l8.intro.5: camp.rival_titan|Nine tons against one and a half. Physics is on my side.
strings.dlg.ch6_l8.intro.6: camp.char_qin|Spark, a semi turns slow and brakes slower. Make it chase you. Lead it to the edge of the pit.
strings.dlg.ch6_l8.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Nine tons of monster... toppled beside the furnace! Titan is down!
strings.dlg.ch6_l8.outro.4: camp.char_yu|This big rig belongs to our team now! I'm turning it into a mobile repair station!
strings.dlg.ch6_l8.outro.5: camp.char_qin|Next stop: Neon Heights. Bai's star driver is waiting.
strings.dlg.ch7_l1.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|Welcome to the Neon Heights livestream! Streamer and driver Nightingale brings you tonight's opening show!
strings.dlg.ch7_l1.intro.2: camp.rival_neon|Watch closely, fam! Tonight's prey is that Rustvale bumpkin, Spark! Hit a hundred thousand likes and I'll push Spark off the roof!
strings.dlg.ch7_l1.intro.3: camp.char_yu|She has eight million followers... all bought and paid for by Mr. Bai.
strings.dlg.ch7_l1.outro.1: camp.rival_neon|...My people went over the edge? Don't leave, fam, I'll win the next one for sure!
strings.dlg.ch7_l1.outro.2: camp.char_spark|She doesn't seem like a bad person.
strings.dlg.ch7_l1.outro.3: camp.char_qin|In the League, the ones who don't seem bad are usually the ones with the least choice.
strings.dlg.ch7_l2.intro.1: camp.rival_ghost|The Neon Arcade: bumpers, spinners, a glowing capture zone. Nightingale's favorite stage.
strings.dlg.ch7_l2.intro.2: camp.rival_wolf|Three-on-three King of the Hill. Don't let the bumpers bounce you into a spinner.
strings.dlg.ch7_l2.outro.1: camp.rival_neon|Lost again... the chat is flooding with "Nightingale, step down."
strings.dlg.ch7_l2.outro.2: camp.rival_neon|(whispering) Mr. Bai is going to be angry...
strings.dlg.ch7_l3.intro.1: camp.char_bai|Spark, you've come too far. Stop here and I'll let you retire with dignity.
strings.dlg.ch7_l3.intro.2: camp.char_spark|Did someone say that to Qin back then too?
strings.dlg.ch7_l3.intro.3: camp.char_bai|...Qin never knew when to quit. I hope you're smarter than him.
strings.dlg.ch7_l3.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Only Spark's car remains on the helipad!
strings.dlg.ch7_l3.outro.2: camp.char_bai|Very well. Then I'll see you at the final. I'll show you what a true Crash King looks like.
strings.dlg.ch7_l4.intro.1: camp.rival_neon|Fam! Tonight is a Bounty Hunt and the target is Spark! Whoever wrecks Spark, bubble tea's on me for everyone!
strings.dlg.ch7_l4.intro.2: camp.char_yu|Hey! The bubble tea thing is MY bit!
strings.dlg.ch7_l4.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Not a single bounty hunter could wreck Spark!
strings.dlg.ch7_l4.outro.2: camp.rival_neon|...Why aren't you scared? Mr. Bai's people are everywhere.
strings.dlg.ch7_l4.outro.3: camp.char_spark|Because the people beside me are worth more than his.
strings.dlg.ch7_l5.intro.1: camp.rival_neon|Spark! Get out! Bai sent people to the roof — this isn't a match, they want you dead!
strings.dlg.ch7_l5.outro.1: camp.rival_neon|Mr. Bai ordered me to eliminate you myself on stream. If I don't, I'm the next one to have an "accident."
strings.dlg.ch7_l5.outro.2: camp.rival_neon|So on the night of the duel, hit me with everything. Don't hold back — he can't suspect a thing.
strings.dlg.ch7_l5.outro.4: camp.rival_neon|And then I'll give you something.
strings.dlg.ch7_l6.intro.1: camp.rival_scorpion|That Nightingale girl... she's exactly like me five years ago.
strings.dlg.ch7_l6.intro.2: camp.char_spark|You think we can trust her too?
strings.dlg.ch7_l6.intro.3: camp.rival_scorpion|I think she needs someone to trust her.
strings.dlg.ch7_l6.outro.1: camp.rival_scorpion|Best of five, clean as anything. ...Spark, I want in for the final too.
strings.dlg.ch7_l7.intro.1: camp.char_yu|Tomorrow is Nightingale's stream showdown. I replaced every part on your car — paid for them myself, not one from League supply!
strings.dlg.ch7_l7.intro.2: camp.char_qin|Last warm-up tonight. Don't get hurt.
strings.dlg.ch7_l7.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Tomorrow night, atop Neon Heights! Nightingale versus Spark, streamed worldwide!
strings.dlg.ch7_l7.outro.3: camp.char_yu|For what? Just remember you owe me for bubble tea.
strings.dlg.ch7_l8.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|Eighty million viewers live! The Neon Queen Nightingale versus Spark of Rustvale!
strings.dlg.ch7_l8.intro.2: camp.rival_neon|Fam, tonight is the most important stream of my life. ...Please, watch until the very end.
strings.dlg.ch7_l8.intro.3: camp.char_bai|(from the VIP box) Nightingale, don't disappoint me.
strings.dlg.ch7_l8.intro.4: camp.rival_neon|Spark, remember our deal — give it everything!
strings.dlg.ch7_l8.intro.5: camp.char_spark|Don't worry. I've never thrown a match in my life.
strings.dlg.ch7_l8.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Nightingale... is defeated! The crown of Neon Heights goes to Spark!
strings.dlg.ch7_l8.outro.2: camp.rival_neon|Fam, I lost. But before I end the stream, I want to play you a recording.
strings.dlg.ch7_l8.outro.3: camp.char_bai|(recording) "...Before the final, cut Qin's brake line. I'll keep the champion's seat for you, Ah Ying."
strings.dlg.ch7_l8.outro.4: camp.char_announcer|Th-that's Mr. Bai's voice?! The stream is exploding!
strings.dlg.ch7_l8.outro.5: camp.rival_neon|This car is yours, Spark. I don't need it anymore — I'm free.
strings.dlg.ch7_l8.outro.6: camp.char_qin|The Grand Final... is in three days.
strings.dlg.ch8_l1.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|Crash League Finals Week begins! Despite the chairman's scandal, the show goes on!
strings.dlg.ch8_l1.intro.2: camp.char_bai|Scandal? Just an edited recording. The League charter is crystal clear: the champion has the final say.
strings.dlg.ch8_l1.intro.3: camp.char_qin|He wants to bury it all under the champion's name. If Bai Ye defends the title, he gets away with it.
strings.dlg.ch8_l1.intro.5: camp.char_qin|Mr. Bai's son. Three-time reigning Crash King.
strings.dlg.ch8_l1.outro.1: camp.rival_crown|So you're the one giving my father headaches?
strings.dlg.ch8_l1.outro.2: camp.rival_crown|Don't misunderstand. I don't care about his business. I only care about who's strongest.
strings.dlg.ch8_l2.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|Championship Ring, Ring Out! A sweeper arm in the middle, three lives, last car standing advances!
strings.dlg.ch8_l2.intro.2: camp.rival_rust|Ha, no rails again. Kid, you trained for this on the Junk Tower!
strings.dlg.ch8_l2.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Spark advances to the final four!
strings.dlg.ch8_l2.outro.2: camp.char_bai|...Officials. Arrange some "special" opponents for Spark's next match.
strings.dlg.ch8_l3.intro.1: camp.char_yu|Mr. Bai changed the format! A "team exhibition" — the other side is all pro enforcers in hypercars!
strings.dlg.ch8_l3.intro.2: camp.rival_rust|Hypercars? Ha! Thin skins, big fillings. One hit and they shatter!
strings.dlg.ch8_l3.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Bai's pro team is annihilated! Spark and the old crew storm into the semifinal!
strings.dlg.ch8_l3.outro.3: camp.rival_rust|What's wrong with antiques? Antiques are the toughest!
strings.dlg.ch8_l4.intro.1: camp.rival_neon|I found it! Mr. Bai has a stash of cheat parts hidden in the Colosseum, ready to bolt onto Bai Ye's car before the final.
strings.dlg.ch8_l4.intro.2: camp.rival_ghost|I know those crates. Ten years ago, that's where I took the blade from.
strings.dlg.ch8_l4.intro.3: camp.char_qin|Smash them all. The final will be clean.
strings.dlg.ch8_l4.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|The Colosseum backstage is in ruins! Word is the chairman's private storeroom has been flattened!
strings.dlg.ch8_l4.outro.3: camp.rival_crown|Spark, I don't need any "parts" for the final. I'll crush you with skill alone.
strings.dlg.ch8_l5.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|The semifinal! Steel Dome, Team Elimination in pairs, best of five!
strings.dlg.ch8_l5.intro.2: camp.rival_ghost|Old master, let me ride with Spark this time. I want to win the right way, just once.
strings.dlg.ch8_l5.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Spark and Ghost storm into the Grand Final! A master-apprentice feud from ten years ago becomes a partnership!
strings.dlg.ch8_l5.outro.2: camp.rival_ghost|...So this is what winning feels like.
strings.dlg.ch8_l6.intro.1: camp.char_bai|A pre-final "security drill." Six armored heavies, three minutes. If you can't hold out... that's an accident.
strings.dlg.ch8_l6.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|All six security heavies are down! Spark stands untouched in the middle of the Colosseum!
strings.dlg.ch8_l6.outro.4: camp.rival_crown|I'm going to face Spark fair and square. Interfere again and I'll give up the title.
strings.dlg.ch8_l7.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|The pre-final exhibition... wait, that black muscle car is—!
strings.dlg.ch8_l7.intro.2: camp.char_announcer|The champion of ten years ago, "Iron Fist" Qin! He's back!
strings.dlg.ch8_l7.intro.3: camp.char_qin|"Old Black" says it wants one more race. So do I.
strings.dlg.ch8_l7.intro.4: camp.rival_rust|Qin! Just like old times, you take left, I take right!
strings.dlg.ch8_l7.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Eighty thousand fans on their feet! Iron Fist Qin still has it!
strings.dlg.ch8_l7.outro.2: camp.char_qin|Spark, I've taught you everything I can.
strings.dlg.ch8_l7.outro.3: camp.char_qin|Tomorrow, go take back what belongs to us.
strings.dlg.ch8_l8.intro.1: camp.char_announcer|The Crash League Grand Final! The Crash Colosseum, eighty thousand fans, broadcast worldwide!
strings.dlg.ch8_l8.intro.2: camp.char_announcer|The defending champion, three-time Crash King — BAI YE! The challenger, who crashed all the way up from the Rustvale scrapyard — SPARK!
strings.dlg.ch8_l8.intro.3: camp.rival_crown|This three-and-a-half-ton Zhenyue has never lost.
strings.dlg.ch8_l8.intro.4: camp.char_spark|Neither has mine. Not today, anyway.
strings.dlg.ch8_l8.intro.5: camp.rival_crown|I won't apologize for what my father did. But today there are no parts, no arrangements. Just you and me.
strings.dlg.ch8_l8.outro.1: camp.char_announcer|Bai Ye... is down! A new Crash King is born — SPARK!!
strings.dlg.ch8_l8.outro.2: camp.rival_crown|...You win. A real Crash King should be someone like you.
strings.dlg.ch8_l8.outro.3: camp.rival_crown|Take the car. And — the League council has received all of Nightingale's recordings. My father has been removed.
strings.dlg.ch8_l8.outro.5: camp.char_spark|Qin, this championship belongs to all of us.
strings.dlg.ch8_l8.outro.6: camp.char_yu|So — new Crash King, when's the bubble tea on you?
